{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate rows based on patient_id
duplicates = df.duplicated(subset=['patient_id'], keep=False)

duplicate_count = duplicates.sum()

duplicate_rows = df[duplicates]

# Print results in a safe way
print('Duplicate patient_id count:', duplicate_count)
if duplicate_count > 0:
    print('Duplicate rows:')
    print(duplicate_rows)
else:
    print('No duplicates found.')"}
